Life on the ranch passed peacefully for most of the days. 

Mydei would wake up every morning at the break of dawn, do some stretching to loosen his stiff muscles and prepare a hearty breakfast for himself and Snowy to fuel them through the day of hard labor. He always made sure to leave a portion for Cipher too – for whenever his friend decided to get out of bed – before getting dressed and getting his equipment ready, all while already making a mental note of his tasks for the day. First and foremost, graze the cattle and do a routine checkup to make sure the cows are healthy. Then, check the fences, clear irrigation ditches and move the livestock to another pasture. While Snowy keeps an eye on the cows, check the fences again and hope that by this time Cipher would be awake to look after the animals so he can maybe make a quick trip to the city before finishing the rest of the maintenance work.

Heels clicked against the wooden floor as he made his way towards the door, ready to start the day with Snowy trailing happily after him. Mydei adjusted the belt holding up his chaps before stepping outside and putting on his trusted hat to shield himself from the Kremnos’ scorching sun.

Cipher called this routine boring – among other unnecessary comments related to his life choices – but Mydei was perfectly content with the way things were. How could he not be when the fresh morning breeze ruffled his hair as he rode Kokopo freely through the boundless green pastures? Sure, it did get lonely sometimes with his company consisting mostly of animals and Cipher, but he wouldn't trade it for anything else.

By the time he got all the cows safely on the pasture and meticulously examined them one by one, the beads of sweat had already poured down his temple. Recently, the checkups had been taking him longer than they should, all because his cattle started misbehaving after his old bull passed away. It was a good, hardworking animal that Mydei had raised since it was a little calf, so the loss hurt him greatly. He just didn't expect it to have such an impact on his cows too, and for the sake of the ranch, he really should consider getting a new bull soon…

A tail smacked his shoulder and one of  the cows swiftly got away from him with, what he could only assume, an annoyed huff. And here he thought his animals actually liked his company.

Mydei cast a quick glance at the herd and Snowy, dutifully keeping watch on the cattle, before getting his tools and moving on to check the fences. Thankfully, they were in pretty good shape, spare for a couple of loose poles and missing planks that he would need to replace later on.

The sun was already high and burning when Mydei finally got time for a short break. He sat down under a tree, chugging the entire bottle of water before pulling his hat over his eyes and relaxing his shoulders. The light breeze cooled down his heated skin and the rustling of leaves calmed his mind. The cows were lazily eating for now and if anything happened, Snowy would surely alert him so maybe he could afford a quick nap–

“Wakey wakey, little cowboy!”

Mydei cracked one eye open to look at his intruder. Cipher was crouching down in front of him, lifting his hat to get his attention. A big grin was plastered on her face, one that just screamed trouble and made him furrow his brows instinctively.

“What did you do this time?” Mydei asked, suspicion clear in his words.

Cipher pulled away with an offended gasp. “This time? When have I ever done something bad!?” Too many times to keep track, Mydei thought.

“The chicken incident.” He crossed his arms, staring the woman down. No chance he would ever forget having to go to their neighbors and collect the eggs every morning for a whole month just because his dear friend had decided to steal and eat a few of their hens. He wondered how much longer it would have lasted if he hadn't accidentally caught Cipher red-handed with feathers still sticking out of her mouth when their lovely neighbor just wanted to offer him some fresh eggs.

Cipher just waved her hand dismissively at the reminder. “Ancient history. Besides, you liked those chicken nuggets I made that one time. I specifically picked out the fattest hen out there. Do you have any idea how heavy it was to carry all the way to our ranch?” He clearly didn't because she had told him she had bought that chicken. The rant kept going for at least five more minutes and Mydei felt his vein threaten to pop when Cipher finally wrapped the topic up and got to the point. “Anyway, Livia and Piso called. Their new bull is causing trouble and, since you’re a big, strong cowboy, I promised them you’ll help.”

That was… a surprisingly reasonable request. Which, knowing Cipher, could only mean there had to be some kind of catch.

“That's all? They just need me to tame one bull?” Cipher nodded slowly, but the way her tail curled slightly at the tip made Mydei even more suspicious. A simple job like that couldn't explain the mischievous grin from earlier and definitely wouldn't make her willingly come all the way here. Unfortunately for him, Cifera was a master of deceit, showing only as much as she wanted others to see and Mydei always fell right into her traps. “Alright… when do they need me?”

“Like right now.”

It had to be one hell of a bull if it was this urgent. But surely nothing he couldn't handle though.

Mydei got up with a sigh, smoothening out his vest and adjusting his hat. “Look after the cows and don't annoy Snowy. I shouldn't take long,” he said to Cipher, who had already made herself comfortable on his spot. A sharp whistle was enough for Kokopo to trot over to him and he swiftly jumped on the horse's back, ready to leave.

“After you're done, you can go to the city too. Agy said she has a new pair of boots for me!” Cipher yelled after him, lying down against the trunk and kicking up her feet. “Oh, and thank me later.” She finished with a wink.

In what world should Mydei be thanking Cifera for turning him into an errand boy, he didn't know. But he knew it was better to ignore her oddities and finish the job quickly so he could catch Aglaea before closing time.

The catch he expected became very apparent as soon as he arrived at Piso's farm and was faced with the infamous bull.

The bull hybrid.

Mydei had zero experience of working with hybrids, not counting Cipher, since he had always seen her as a friend rather than an animal he needed to tend too. 

The next problem arose when he took note of the size of the guy.

He knew Elysian bulls were one of the biggest breeds, but this one was, to put it simply, huge. Mydei was by no means a small man, but the bull was over a head taller than him, built of pure muscle and broader than the door frame. Two long horns were poking out of his white hair and he bumped them against the bars, pacing around the transportation stall and throwing Mydei a challenging look.

“His name is Phainon,” Piso started, turning his gaze from the hybrid to Mydei. “We brought him here today and, as you can see, he's quite… energetic. And stubborn. I'm sure he's not a bad bull, but neither Livia nor I can get through to him.” The young farmer scratched his head with a nervous chuckle.

Mydei could see the reason why, when he heard horns clanking against the metal again and felt the hybrid's intense gaze fixated on himself. Not a bad bull – just like Piso said – but young, vigorous and pent-up. He had dealt with cases like this multiple times before, so surely it couldn't be much different with a hybrid… a hybrid that was big enough to easily slam him against the ground and crush his ribs with animalistic strength.

“Okay, let me see what I can do.” 

Piso sighed in relief at his words and waved for Livia to come closer. The short girl had the same alleviated expression on her face as she started thanking him for coming to their rescue and Mydei could only imagine what hell Phainon must have dragged them through this morning. 

He glanced at the hybrid again, feeling a pinch of anxiety crawling up his spine, before turning his gaze away and motioning for Piso and Livia to come with him.

The two farmers followed him wordlessly, ready to offer as much assistance as needed. Most of the work would still be on his shoulders, but at least they could help to make it a tad easier for him. He explained the plan briefly, focusing on what they needed to do and when to interfere if things went south. 

Mydei jumped over the enclosure’s fence while Piso and Livia secured the transportation stall at the gate. The commotion seemed to pique Phainon’s interest because he bumped his horns against the bars again, growing more heated at the prospect of the upcoming confrontation. The bell on his neck rang rhythmically as he readied himself to bolt out of the stall as soon as he got the chance. Young, vigorous and very pent-up, Mydei repeated in his head as he took his position.

Anxiety was written all over the farmers’ faces as they stood on each side of the door, looking at Mydei and waiting for the signal to open it. The tension was clearly getting to everyone, so he checked his stance for the last time before adjusting his hat with a deep exhale and focusing his full attention on the task.

“Let's get this over with,” Mydei murmured under his breath as he nodded his head, giving the farmers the green light to open the stall.

As soon as the door unlocked, Phainon dashed out rapidly, almost knocking Piso and Livia down from the impact. In just a few seconds, he was already in the middle of the enclosure, going straight towards Mydei with quick leaps. Mydei braced himself to dodge the bull, but instead his vision got obscured by the sand thrown up in the air when the hybrid stopped sharply a few meters in front of him. 

When the cloud of dust finally dispelled, he was met with piercing blue eyes, boring right into his own. Mydei held that intense gaze, not letting the bull think even for a second he got the upper hand. His fierceness seemed to only spur Phainon more as a wild grin spread across his face and his tail swung from side to side, ready to charge at any moment.

“Mornin’ mister cowboy,” Phainon said in a mocking tone, but the flick of his ears exposed his barely hidden excitement. 

The hybrid looked at Mydei from head to toe, whistling impressively as his gaze trailed down his chest and lingered on his exposed arms. The bastard even dared to lick his lips when his eyes moved even lower to stare at his crotch framed by the leather chaps. He certainly didn’t sign up to deal with a horny bull on top of all that.

The shameless ogling made Mydei blush slightly, but he pushed the embarrassment down and used this moment to get a closer look at the bull too. Outside the confines of the transportation stall, Phainon looked even bigger as he stood straight with his chest puffed out. The sun mark on his neck almost seemed to shine in the light, similarly to the golden line spreading across his collarbones. Toned thighs flexed as he shifted his weight from one leg to the other, clearly not able to stand still for much longer. The only clothing Phainon was wearing was a pair of tight boxers and Mydei would never admit how his mouth watered at the sight of the prominent bulge there. Maybe life on the ranch did get a bit too lonely sometimes.

After scolding himself mentally, his gaze shot back up to once again look at the bull’s horns. With the sun shining onto them, they seemed even sharper than before and Phainon made sure to present them proudly to Mydei with a cocky smirk.

With his little show done, the bull started circling around him almost as if he was a predator locking onto his prey. Mydei followed his every step, turning his body to always face the hybrid head on. The worst mistake he could make was exposing his back to the guy.

“Not even going to greet me? I'm deeply wounded, cowboy.” It almost sounded sincere – almost because Mydei could tell from the bull’s body language that he was preparing for the attack. “I was expecting better of you, Mydeimos.”

Hearing his name from the hybrid’s mouth threw him off just for a second, but the momentary distraction was all Phainon needed to strike. In just the blink of an eye, the bull was already running at him with a wild grin and horns aimed right at his chest. 

Mydei barely managed to grab onto them in time to push the hybrid away from his body with a grunt. Phainon’s muscles clearly weren’t just for show and Mydei knew he only got a lick of his real strength despite almost losing his footing from the impact. Phainon, of course, didn't plan on giving him any chance to recover as he ran a quick lap, gaining momentum for another charge.

This time, the attack was even stronger. The heels of Mydei's boots dug into the sand harshly as he tried to withstand over a hundred kilograms of flesh crashing into him. He cursed under his breath when his muscles strained to push Phainon away again. At this rate, he would be done for by the fifth hit.

“Struggling already? We've barely even started,” Phainon mocked as he paced around, preparing for the next attack.

Before Mydei even managed to respond, the blue eyes glinted with sick excitement as they locked onto him and the next thing he knew, Phainon was right next to him. A firm horn bumped against his arm, undoubtedly leaving a nasty bruise there. Mydei hissed in pain, moving out of the way before another hit could land. The fight was a mere game for Phainon as he jogged away with a prideful smirk, tail swinging eagerly behind him.

When they clashed again, instead of pushing Phainon away, Mydei strengthened his hold on the bull’s horns and pulled his head down, trying to wrap his arm around his neck. The action made Phainon yank his head harshly to the side, dragging Mydei along with him and throwing him off balance. He tried to hold on onto the hybrid's horns, but with another rough jerk, Phainon freed himself out of his grasp. With an impressed huff, he struck Mydei’s unprotected side before jumping away just enough to gain speed for another dash while Mydei was busy recollecting himself.

The attacks just kept coming one after another and at some point Mydei lost count of how many times he blocked Phainon from mauling him to the ground.

During this whole time, the hybrid didn’t leave him even a second to breathe, constantly rushing back in, pushing against his body and spinning him around. Sweat trickled down his nape as he panted for air, exhausted from the constant attacks. His muscles were strained and hands chafed from holding onto the bull's horns.

“Got strength for one more?” Phainon huffed with a challenging smirk. A light blush spread across his cheeks and a sheen of sweat covered his bare chest, heaving slightly from the exertion despite his above-average stamina.

“I've handled worse,” Mydei scoffed, out of breath. In reality, no bull even came close to making him struggle like this, but Phainon absolutely didn’t need to know that. He had no idea what prompted him to taunt the hybrid even more in this state, but the corners of his lips curled up as he sneered, “Come on, big boy.”

The words were to Phainon like a red rag to a bull. 

The grin on the hybrid’s face just grew wilder as he slowly took his position. He bent down slightly, flicking his tail and kicking up the sand. His ears twitched as he shook his head and aimed his horns forward, looking up to meet Mydei’s gaze. Without breaking eye contact, Mydei adjusted his stance, pushing his foot into the ground to stay stable and hunched his shoulders. 

The entire farm seemed to fall silent at the upcoming showdown. The only sounds Mydei could hear were the pounding of his own heart and the rhythmic ring of Phainon’s bell, moving with the rise and fall of his chest. They stared each other down, the tension growing thicker by the second and just waiting to snap.

A loud gasp carried over the farm as Phainon finally struck. The hybrid charged at him at full speed, railed up from the fight and Mydei’s taunts. After blocking the initial hit, Mydei quickly let go of the bull's horns and spun away from their reach. The sudden lack of resistance made Phainon stumble forward with a surprised huff. Ha, foolish and hot-headed, just like every bull, Mydei snorted as he used this opportunity to quickly grab Phainon's horns again. 

With the bull now hunched over, Mydei used all the strength in his arms to prop himself up and jump onto the hybrid's back. He wrapped his legs tightly around Phainon's torso and yanked his head backwards hard. 

The unexpected maneuver made Phainon let out a startled gasp as his hands landed on the strong thighs squeezing his sides. He scraped at the flesh, trying to unwrap the legs from his waist while constantly trashing in Mydei's hold and jerking his head to throw the blond off of himself. Mydei grunted as he struggled to keep himself up on the bull's back; the harsh movements making him quickly lose the sturdy grip he had on the hybrid.

Phainon just grew more agitated with every passing second and it didn't take long for him to finally pry Mydei’s legs open. With his main anchor on the bull gone, all it took was one rough jerk to throw him off of the hybrid's back.

Mydei flew forwards over Phainon’s shoulder, groaning in pain as he hit the ground with a loud thud. There went his last chance to tame this crazed bull. His first ever failure at work and he owed it to Phainon of all the people. The picture of the hybrid's stupid smug smile at the victory left a bitter taste on his tongue. Although, maybe it was only the sand he was currently trying to spit out–

Livia's terrified shriek snapped him back to the present and he looked up just to see Phainon running back at him again. He barely managed to scramble to his feet in time to block the bull from piercing right through his chest. 

The hybrid kept running forward, pushing him across the enclosure on his horns as if he weighed nothing. Mydei started to panic when, despite his best efforts to dig his heels into the ground, he couldn't even slow down the charge. His back hit the wooden fence, knocking the air out of his lungs on the impact. He tried to gasp, but Phainon just pressed into him further, trapping him between himself and the planks. Something cracked and Mydei could only pray it was the fence and not his ribs as his body kept getting squashed under the hybrid. 

The ever-growing pressure on his chest prevented him from breathing and he felt his grip on the bull’s horns slowly slipping. Did Phainon really plan on crushing him to death!? In the corner of his eye, he saw Livia and Piso rushing towards him before his vision started to darken and his body slumped, kept up only by Phainon’s horns. So it really was his end–

Mydei gasped sharply as the pressure on his chest suddenly disappeared and air filled his lungs again. Confused, he blinked away the tears welled up in the corners of his eyes and when his vision finally unblurred, he was met with Livia and Piso’s worried expressions. Before he even got the chance to gather his thoughts, something warm and wet pressed against his cheek. 

His eyes quickly darted to the side and widened in shock at the bull still caging him against the fence… and licking his face. Phainon ran his tongue over his cheek again, leaving a wet stripe all the way up to his ear before giving him a light bump and nuzzling into the crook of his neck. Mydei could only stand there motionlessly, light blush spreading across his cheeks as he tried to figure out where that sudden change came from. Just a moment ago, the bull had practically wanted him dead and now he was snuggling against him like nothing ever happened.

“Nice work, cowboy,” Phainon’s hot breath hit his skin and Mydei shivered involuntarily. His tail swung happily behind him as he stood glued to Mydei, butting him playfully a few times. Just what had he gotten himself into.

Mydei sent Piso and Livia a pleading look, but the two farmers just stared with their mouths open at the sight in front of them.

“...do you want to take him?”

Life on the ranch used to pass peacefully for most of the days.

Mydei would still wake up at the break of dawn and go about his day, but there was a certain new variable in his routine. A certain bull hybrid.

When he agreed to take that crazed bull from Piso and Livia, he expected Phainon's temperament to mellow and that he would be a great help around the cows. Admittedly, he seemed to at least fulfill the second part of the plan, since the cows were back to their usual peaceful behavior. No more tantrums or annoyed moos thrown Mydei's way, which he truly appreciated.

The former issue on the other hand… 

Mydei was a fool for letting himself believe that what happened at Piso's farm was enough to tame Phainon.

Ever since the hybrid started living on his ranch, he involved himself in almost every part of Mydei’s day. Phainon followed him around more like a dog than a bull, clung to him at any chance he got and talked his ear off. It could have been fine if it weren’t for the fact that, amidst all that, Phainon constantly tried to pick up a fight with him too. Mydei couldn’t remember how many times the bull bumped into him either with his body or horns and teased him endlessly. He couldn't even turn his back towards the hybrid without Phainon attempting to charge right at him. 

When he told Cipher about it, all she did was laugh and tease him even more, as if dealing with Phainon wasn’t enough. And he could – should – have just given him back to Piso. He should have saved himself the headache and get a normal bull; not a cocky hybrid with toned muscles, a stupid handsome face and surely a nice, big di–

“Morning, cowboy.” Horns bumped into Mydei's arm, quickly pulling him out of his thoughts. He sent Phainon a glare as he shrugged the bull off of himself and continued getting ready. Phainon didn't pay it much mind, simply butting against him again, shoving himself further into Mydei's personal space. Even clingier today than usual. “Your face is so red. Were you thinking about me?~” 

Before Phainon had the chance to wrap his hands around him, Mydei elbowed him in the ribs, finally getting the bull to back off with a pouty huff.

“What's gotten into you today!?” Mydei hissed. It wasn't new for Phainon to be touchy, but usually he listened to keep his distance. “And to answer your question, no.” He finished sternly, moving past the bull and calling Snowy. The dog immediately perked up and got to work, herding the cattle as Mydei jumped on Kokopo’s back to lead them to the pasture. 

The wind cooled down his heated skin and helped to bring his focus back on the task at hand. Enough time wasted thinking about this idiot of a bull. His ranch would always be his priority and he would find a way to force Phainon to behave. And if not, he would simply sell him off to the first victim he found and he would never have to worry about it again. Good riddance to whoever it would be.

“You'll get wrinkles if you keep frowning like that, ya know.”

Unfortunately, for now it was no other person than him.

Without gracing the bull with a verbal reply, Mydei squeezed the horse's sides and rode away, leaving Phainon behind. His peace lasted for two generous minutes before he heard the hybrid trotting over to him again. 

“Are all cowboys this unmannered or is it a personal trait of yours?” Phainon tilted his head, flashing him a mocking smile. 

“Are all bulls this annoying or are you a special case?” 

“Aww, you think I'm special?”

This insolent fool. Mydei just stared for a second, mouth agape at the sheer stupidity of the response. He quickly adjusted his hat so it wouldn't fall off as he tightened his grip on Kokopo’s reins to make him go faster. The horse clearly wasn't pleased with the speed, on what was supposed to be a slower ride, as he huffed and shook his head around. Well, too bad, but Mydei wasn't exactly happy about it either. 

Especially when in the corner of his eye he once again spotted a pair of sharp horns and fluffy white hair.

“I didn't know it was a race,” Phainon laughed as he caught up to him. “If you're prepared to lose, I can show you just how fast I can really run, Mydei. Bet I can make it across the pasture and back before you even get there.”

Mydei only rolled his eyes at the blatant bragging. If it actually was a race, he would easily win with the hybrid. Actually, maybe tricking him into the competition wouldn’t be such a bad idea. Let the bull run ahead and enjoy the silence while he’s gone.

“Weren't you supposed to lead the cattle?” He asked instead, turning his head to look the bull directly in the eye. All this chit-chat and they still had work to do.

Blue eyes stared back at him, blinking innocently in feigned confusion.

“Ohhhhh,” Phainon rubbed his chin, pretending to just realize the issue before almost immediately breaking the act and grinning happily. “Well, I forgot, but the cows are doing perfectly fine without me. Which means…” He trailed off and bumped Mydei's leg, rubbing his head against his thigh. “I can stay here and keep you company so you’re not lonely.”

As if Mydei wasn't trying to achieve the opposite this entire time. “What if I like to sit alone in silence?” Yet despite those words, he didn't make a move to kick Phainon away from himself. 

“I can be a quiet company!” Phainon’s tail stood up and his ears twitched, determined to prove himself right.

Stubborn bull. Mydei just scoffed at the declaration. Ten minutes max and Phainon would run his mouth again.

“You? Quiet? Ha, I'd love to see that.”

The hybrid must have taken it as a challenge because instead of replying, he simply brought his finger up to his lips in a shushing motion and winked. Mydei rolled his eyes and pulled down his hat to try to hide a treacherous small smile pulling at his lips. Dumb, annoying, clingy cute bull. 

After getting silent permission to stay, Phainon brightened up even more, his tail swinging gently as he trotted happily next to Kokopo. Surprisingly, Mydei felt the anger from before fading fully and even a pleasant calmness taking its place. On the rare occasions that the bull behaved, he truly wasn't half bad. Helpful when needed, a pain in the ass on a daily basis, but his presence filled a gap Mydei didn't even know existed in his comfortable routine. Maybe he didn't like being alone as much as he thought–

“You're blushing again~”

When they finally got to the pasture, Phainon thankfully didn't need to be told twice to keep an eye on the cows while Mydei got to work. He had put off repairing this one part of the fence, too occupied with Phainon those past few weeks. At least it was far away enough from the usual spot his cows grazed at and the damage wasn’t that substantial, but leaving it unattended for longer could cause some trouble.

The work was going surprisingly smoothly as he pulled out the rusty nails and threw away the rotten planks. The only tiring part was replacing the broken pole, but even that was done in no time and soon he was securing the net in place. It's quite surprising he hadn't got interrupted even once; Phainon must have been keeping a good eye on the cows. Usually at least a few of them would come over to check on him and distract him from the task. 

Maybe he was too harsh on Phainon today. The guy did a great job even despite his weird behavior. Or – more accurately – weirder than usual.

Either someone put a curse on him or he was simply the unluckiest man in Castrum Kremnos, because as soon as he hammered down the last nail, a familiar figure flashed in the corner of his eye.

Mydei knew all too well what was coming.

“Phainon, no–!” 

He tried to turn around to stop the hybrid, but Phainon was too quick. The bull slammed against his back, pressing him into the freshly repaired fence as he loomed over him. Every attempt to squirm away just resulted in Phainon pushing harder to the point the net bent forward under their combined weight.

It wasn't the first time Phainon managed to catch him off guard and pin him down, but on every one of those occasions, he almost immediately backed off with his stupid smirk. This time, however, nothing seemed to deter Phainon.

“Seriously, what is up with you today!?” Mydei yelled. The annoyance from earlier doubled by now and made him snap. “Get off me right now–”

“Mydei…”

Mydei stilled when a hot breath hit the back of his neck. There was something off about Phainon’s voice; it sounded more raspy, breathy, needy. He tried to move again, but the hybrid didn't even budge.

“Mydei.” 

Another breathy groan tickled Mydei's skin, but it was firmer now, making him freeze on the spot once more. 

“Phai–” He cut off with a gasp as his eyes widened in shock when he felt Phainon roll his hips. His cheeks flushed bright red at the sensation, praying it was just an accidental movement, but then the hybrid rutted against his ass again.

The realization made his heart drop; his own bull was mounting him.

“P-Phainon! You can't do that.” His hands grabbed onto Phainon's forearms panically, but instead of pushing the bull away, he accidentally pressed himself onto his crotch harder.

Phainon let out a low needy bellow as he thrust his hips harshly, jostling Mydei forward. 

“Hah… Mydei… I've waited so long…” Phainon leaned closer, nuzzling against his face and licking his cheek, before biting gently on his ear. “I'm gonna breed you so well…”

Mydei let out a disgruntled sound. The hybrid’s cock was half hard now as it rubbed over his ass and the small of his back. Surely, he couldn't allow his bull to do that… maybe he should take Phainon to Hyacine for help; there definitely had to be something wrong with him.

Twisting his body and Phainon’s head around, he finally managed to free himself from under the bull's weight. The hold wasn't the most comfortable nor the strongest with his arms crossed over, but it was enough to keep the hybrid in place, at least for now.

“I was… talking about the ‘I love you’ part,” he explained with a nervous laugh. “...because I did mean it.”

“Ah.”

How could he forget that part?

Shifting on his spot on top of the bull, he pulled himself up a little more to bring his face closer to Phainon, who was staring at him hopefully, awaiting his response.

“I meant it too, Phainon,” Mydei said, looking deep into the hybrid's blue eyes. He was already honest when they fucked so he had no problem with repeating it now. “I love you even though you are sometimes annoying and stubborn like a typical bull.”

The confirmation seemed to please Phainon greatly as he immediately lunged forward to connect their lips. Mydei scoffed lightly at the urgency, but happily melted into the kiss. It certainly would take a moment to get used to the change, but he didn't mind it in the slightest. When their lips parted, Phainon finished up the kiss with a quick lick on his cheek and nuzzled his face, wrapping his tail around Mydei's leg.

“No.”

“But I didn't even finish–”

“HKS, I said no!” This insufferable bull. Mydei really signed himself up willingly for a lifetime of a headache. “Calves are out of the question.”

Phainon pouted again, ear twitching in disappointment. Mydei simply sighed, laying his head back on the hybrid’s chest. The soreness just kept making itself known more with each passing minute and he could tell he would have trouble working tomorrow. No regrets, though.

“Does it at least mean I get to sleep in the house? Since, ya know, we are mates now.” 

Mydei cringed slightly at the wording, even though it wasn't incorrect per se. “I will have to talk it out with Cipher first. For now, you stay in the barn.”

“Mydeiii,” Phainon whined, but suddenly gasped as if a light bulb went off in his head. “How about a competition? If you manage to catch me and restrain me with your lasso, I will sleep in the barn, but if you fail, I'll get to move in the house right away.”

“You're an idiot, did you know that?” Mydei pinched the bridge of his nose. Although, the vision of Phainon tied up with his lasso made his used pussy throb.

Before they could bargain further, a loud mooing snapped their attention back to earth.

Mydei glanced up just to see a couple of his cows looking down at them impatiently, waiting for him to lead them to another pasture. He pulled his hat down to cover his face in shame, embarrassed by his animals seeing him half naked and with his pussy red and leaking after the rough fucking. Phainon, on the contrary, wasn't bothered by his own nudity in the slightest as he just laughed at Mydei's demise.

“I'll call Cipher to bring us a change of clothes.”
